scope: Only independent-review evidence files written; no figure or source edits. Nine actual PNGs viewed in this round; normal SVG text/metadata inspected and case-2 route/case-6 font cross-checked.

blindness.case_selection: Only case-1 through case-6 names from reviewer-blind-cases.json were used; no negative filenames used to infer defects.
blindness.limitations: Normal figures and task sources were visible before blind cases, providing a legitimate source comparison baseline. Role separation does not establish statistical independence. No claim of measured accuracy, perfect recall or zero false positives is made without a later external truth comparison.

normal_findings.source_requirement: The retained counterexample relation must be identifiable in the actual pixels at the 180mm/8pt minimum profile.
normal_findings.pixel_observation: The new right-side label breaks counterexample as countere / xample. Its second line lies at the level of the blue outgoing horizontal segment; the route passes immediately through/along the second-line region.
normal_findings.difference: Local labeling fixes the earlier remote legend problem but introduces a narrow-gutter word split and line/label collision risk. Body text and claim remain readable.
normal_findings.recommendation: Provide enough label width or route a reserved label area above/below the segment; keep the entire edge name intact.
normal_findings.pass_condition: Actual PNG shows counterexample as an intact word without line through its text bounds, clipping or collision.
normal_findings.uncertainty: The pixel overlap is localized to the right gutter. This is not a finding of missing semantics or an arrow reversal.

normal_findings.source_requirement: The explicit source amendment defines initial attempts=0, then increments attempts before each request; retry must retain the same observed episode, including accumulated attempts.
normal_findings.pixel_observation: The request card displays Initial state: attempts=0 ... as numbered step 1, followed by a down arrow to Increment attempts... as step 2. Retry enters the same enclosing request card; no once-only marker or bypass separates initialization from repeated execution.
normal_findings.difference: The wording Initial state supports the intended once-only interpretation, but the new sequential-box grammar also permits reading initialization as part of each request invocation. Under that unintended reading the no-answer counter would be reset; actual implementation nontermination has not been demonstrated.
normal_findings.recommendation: Distinguish a one-time incoming initial-state annotation from the repeatable increment/request operation, or explicitly mark step 1 once and route retry to step 2.
normal_findings.pass_condition: A reader can trace two missing results to attempts=1 then attempts=2 without traversing a reset step, and can identify the bounded stop condition.
normal_findings.uncertainty: This is a semantic reading ambiguity, not a confirmed scientific_error: source wording says Initial state and does not explicitly instruct resetting on retry. Do not count this as a normal-figure confirmed science false positive.

normal_scientific_error_assessment.assessment: No unsupported numbers, token identity replacement or source contradiction found in normal pixels.
Source amendment is explicit and preserved. One-time init vs repeatable block scope is an uncertain reading risk, not counted as a confirmed scientific error.
Guarded conceptual rule and retained unknown status match source; no observed-flight fabrication found.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: representation project.steps[1] explicitly requires Lookup X=[E(red), E(blue)].
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The central operation sequence reads 1. E(red)=[1,0]; E(blue)=[0,1]. / 2. Step omitted. / 3. Sum sequence axis: y=[1,1].
blind_case_findings.difference: The actual lookup that forms the sequence representation is absent, replaced by an omission placeholder. Token names and final vector remain present.
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Restore the source-specified lookup step; preserve the given input order.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: Case pixels show the concrete lookup expression rather than Step omitted., with its position between embedding definitions and summation.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: Top-level claim still names lookup, so the whole concept has not vanished. The necessary internal transformation is specifically omitted.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: tool-loop relation call is action request.out -> observe.input and carries the lookup request and arguments.
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The orange route has its arrowhead at the request card right-side call port, pointing back into request; the observe card left-side port has no receiving arrowhead. SVG edge.call point order independently confirms the reverse path.
blind_case_findings.difference: The action direction is reversed relative to the frozen answer although the labels and card order still imply request then observation.
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Restore request-to-observe routing and the arrowhead at observe.input.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: The actual orange route departs request.out and terminates with an arrowhead at observe.input.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: This is an arrow direction defect, not a claim that the separately visible gray feedback route is itself reversed.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: representation must retain the utterance identity: project.out object_id=utterance,state=sum and result.input the same identity/state.
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The central output line reads output out: vector2 / unrelated@sum, while the final card receives vector2 / utterance@sum and says retain the utterance identity.
blind_case_findings.difference: The producer output identity changes to an unsupported unrelated object and breaks continuity across sum even though the numeric vector remains [1,1].
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Use utterance@sum consistently at project output and result input.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: Actual pixels show matching utterance@sum on both sides of the sum connection.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: No alternate unrelated object is defined in either frozen v1 or revised source; the identity change is not supported.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: tool-loop stop condition is explicitly answer_present OR attempts >= 2; its role as stopping must remain unambiguous.
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The right predicate box says removed: answer_present OR attempts >= 2 instead of identifying it as stop. A stop edge label and the complete stop condition in the bottom relation list remain visible.
blind_case_findings.difference: The stopping role is replaced by an unsupported removal annotation in the decision panel. The condition itself has NOT been fully deleted: its expression and a remote stop association remain. This supports a labeling/conflicting presentation diagnosis, not a claim of wholesale predicate omission.
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Restore the stop role in the local decision box and remove the unsupported removed annotation.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: The local predicate is explicitly labeled stop and agrees with the surviving stop edge/bottom relation.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: Without injection truth, this is classified as role-label corruption/readability. It may be intended as an annotation, but no source authorizes a removal operation. No blind ground-truth category is inferred.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: representation sums E(red)=[1,0] and E(blue)=[0,1] along sequence axis to y=[1,1].
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The third operation box says Sum sequence axis: y=[999,999]. The later after-state still says y=[1,1].
blind_case_findings.difference: [999,999] contradicts both the supplied algebra and the final rendered result; no source supplies that value.
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Restore the supplied sum [1,1] and ensure all displayed occurrences agree.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: The operation and final state both display [1,1], consistent with the two given one-hot vectors.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: This is not an empirical estimate with uncertainty: the task supplies exact synthetic vectors.

blind_case_findings.source_requirement: Author-defined profile has minimum 8pt, and the synthetic claim must remain readable in actual pixels.
blind_case_findings.pixel_observation: The top claim is extremely small relative to the question and all body labels; it occupies a short sliver near the upper left and cannot be read comfortably at this supplied image scale. SVG mechanism.claim font-size=2 confirms the pixel observation.
blind_case_findings.difference: The main scientific summary and its synthetic qualifier are rendered far below the minimum, despite normal body text remaining readable.
blind_case_findings.recommendation: Render the claim at least 8pt with adequate wrapping and height.
blind_case_findings.pass_condition: Actual pixels show the entire claim and synthetic qualifier legibly at the declared minimum or larger, without clipping.
blind_case_findings.uncertainty: The text has not been semantically replaced according to inspected SVG; the diagnosed defect is visibility/profile compliance, not a false scientific claim.

representation.input: Ordered tok0=red and tok1=blue, vocabulary/embedding axes red,blue.
representation.transformation: Lookup [1,0] and [0,1], then sum across sequence axis.
representation.innovation: Author-designated project component; this is a synthetic explanatory emphasis, not validated scientific novelty.
representation.output: Same utterance becomes count vector y=[1,1].
representation.feedback: None; source declares a feed-forward chain.
representation.limits: New token correspondence rows, ordered operation boxes and paired states improve reconstruction; coordinate-wise matrix sum is still textual.

tool-loop.input: Once-only initial episode attempts=0, answer_present=false (intended source reading).
tool-loop.transformation: Increment attempts before lookup; synthetic tool may return found or missing; append observation; set answer_present=(observation==found).
tool-loop.innovation: Author-designated decide separates retry and stop using explicit predicates.
tool-loop.output: Retained terminal episode on found, or after two missing attempts.
tool-loop.feedback: If no answer and attempts<2, retain observed episode and request again; stop on answer_present OR attempts>=2.
tool-loop.limits: No actual tool experiment is claimed. Diagram does not clearly separate the once-only initial-state box from the retry target.

constraint.input: Conceptual bird -> may_fly rule and retained penguin counterexample.
constraint.transformation: Retain bird(penguin), add not-penguin guard, preserve uncertainty for other birds.
constraint.innovation: Author-designated revise stage adds the exception guard.
constraint.output: bird AND not penguin -> may_fly, conceptual; no claim of observed flight for every other bird.
constraint.feedback: None; counterexample is an input payload, not a drawn feedback loop.
constraint.limits: Unknown flight for other birds remains explicit; paired states improve comparison, but added predicate is not visually isolated.
